question: True or false: ImageNet classifiers lost 11 to 14 points on a fresh test set because of years of tuning to the old one?
answer: False. Recht and colleagues rebuilt the test set by the original recipe, and every model dropped, but in step: rankings held, and gains on the old set carried over to the new. Overfitting would have hurt the most heavily tuned models most. The new images were simply a little harder.
move: Before blaming a cause, check whether everything untouched by it moved too.
ask: Before I blame a cause, did I check whether things it never touched moved too?
trap: Blaming the drop on years of models tuned against one public test.
reference: Recht, Roelofs, Schmidt & Shankar, Do ImageNet Classifiers Generalize to ImageNet?, ICML, 2019
